changes.title: Game playback speed
changes.text: Choose 0.5x, 1x or 2x dungeon playback in APD Settings without changing gameplay turns or combat costs.

changes.title: Dungeon animation timing
changes.text: Dungeon visual groups follow the selected speed while menus, HUD long presses and the actor clock keep their normal timing.

changes.title: Playback regressions
changes.text: Added saved-setting, frame-rate, nested-group, clock-restoration and unchanged-turn-clock regressions for all three speeds.

changes.title: Android speed controls and animations
changes.text: Android checks now select every speed through actual touches and compare real dungeon animation completion times.

changes.title: Playback verification record
changes.text: Recorded the approved playback-only scope, local checks and remaining Android verification.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I added three playback speeds while keeping turn costs and HUD timing unchanged. I am verifying the actual Android controls and animation timing before delivery.

changes.title: Supported hourglass icons
changes.text: Playback entries use SPD's existing hourglass sprite, and the failed no-APK TEST75 attempt is recorded accurately.
